entity.description:
Angelino District is a section of some city on the west coast of the United States of America. Bifurcated by a large storm drain, crisscrossed by overpasses, the area is abandoned by humans, mostly due to the nearby power plant in danger of meltdown, but also because of the frequent meteor strikes and a near-constant struggle between the Autobots and Decepticons.

Angelino District became a battlefield in the Autobot/Decepticon war after they arrived on Earth.
